data.construction: Thermally efficient (low-E glass, foil insulation), typical (31 dB)
data.next_step: AHJ signs the report; then move the job to In service
data.notes:
Worked example (fictional building, people and companies; the radio systems are real FCC licences near the pin).
The free-space pre-survey said every system clears -95 dBm inside, but the walk test before design found -98 to -104 dBm on floors 2 and 3 behind the low-E glass: free space is best case, a walk test decides.
Design: one Class A BDA in the first-floor BDA room, a fiber backbone to each floor, six ceiling antennas a floor.
